description:
Perform a spatial analysis to identify cities located near international borders.

Goal: Export a shapefile containing only populated places that are within 0.5 degrees of any country border.

Starting State: gvSIG Desktop is open with the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer loaded (from the countries_base project).

Expected Actions:
1. Add the populated places layer from '/home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp' to the View.
2. Convert the countries polygon layer to a line layer (representing borders) using the Geoprocessing toolbox (Polygons to lines).
3. Create a fixed distance buffer of 0.5 degrees around the new border lines.
4. Select all features from the populated places layer that intersect with the buffer.
5. Export the selected cities to a new shapefile at '/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/border_cities.shp'.

Final State: A shapefile exists at the export path containing only the cities near borders.
